source_scope: BRAAS technical manual, 222 pages; 87 existing machine records rebuilt as source-bound rules/references; omitted critical table/product pages captured as global facts/catalog data
critical_findings: Legacy titles/classification were heavily text-fragment based; v2.5 replaces all 87 active BRAAS_ROOF_TECH titles and routing classes with source-verified section meanings.

Five legacy records are actually section-heading pages in section 22, not geometry details. They are retained for traceability as reference_section_header and route to the separately processed BRAAS_ROOF_DETAILS junction families.

Critical omitted source pages (slope tables, PUT/LAT, LA averages, AFE, wind clips, ventilation tile tables, product appendices and wind-region table header) are captured as global facts/catalog evidence without fabricating new geometry records.

Page 66 contains a Range 1/Range 2 wording conflict; page 87 contains an Opal wind-clip code conflict; page 199 prints a descending Difodamm installation-temperature range. All remain explicit blockers.
Wind/snow and manufacturer-cited SP/GOST statements are source claims only; no current-code validity is inferred.
